replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
Use of some hacks warrant permanent bans and use of other hacks only warrant temporary bans.
This can be explained with one question; "How badly does this hack affect others?"

For example, Fly Hacking results in a permanent ban because it immediately affects everyone in the game.
Where as X-Ray is only a temporary ban because it doesn't immediately impact everyone who's playing the game.

Autoclicking, although serious, doesn't necessarily affect everyone but it's still quite serious, therefore the temp-ban for autoclicking is harsher than the normal timespan for a temp-ban.

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
It's so obvious this needs to warrant a permanent ban from the network. It's that obvious because of some easy to get reasons, with some common sense on top of it. To actually start with. I'm going to quote some replies or parts of them and will accordingly answer to them regardless if I share the point with them or not.

Autoclicking has always warranted a 10-15 day temporary ban. - SnowSX3
This is a fallacy. More concretely an argumentum ad antiquitatem) – a conclusion supported solely because it has long been held to be true or as it is; also known as Appeal to tradition. So basically this argument doesn't hold any water.

Autoclicking, although serious, doesn't necessarily affect everyone but it's still quite serious, therefore the temp-ban for autoclicking is harsher than the normal timespan for a temp-ban. - SnowSX3
Another fallacy, appeal to probability. We really shouldn't have a set timespan for autoclicking then, because following this fallacy it could be treated differently as if it was immersed in combat, or just to do self-advertising crazy bridges. Permanent ban for both, as every other hack.

All hacks should be permanent. - nintendoboy11
While maybe an autoclicker is not considered a so-called "hack", it can cause the same or even more damage and piss off more players than some advantages you could find in a hacked client, such as sneak. I really support this idea. You hereby acknowledge to abide by the server rules; you can maybe not know about toggle sneak as there are similar environments where it is indeed allowed and it doesn't cause so much damage and so on, autoclicker isn't allowed anywhere with a similar environment as in here; you actually know you are breaking the rules exactly the same as when you decide to flyhack to save yourself from death.

So to sum up, autoclicker warrants a permanent ban as every other known "hack" as of that does; and that's what will get handled in future cases I guess. Just don't autoclick, it's bad.

Have fun o/
